summary.text: Tian Nan true inheritance is the refinement path legacy of Old Eccentric Tian Nan. Eastern Sea's Song clan contests it at Ascending Heaven Plain.

claims.text: Song Qi Yuan tells Song Yi Shi that Ascending Heaven Plain holds Old Eccentric Tian Nan’s inheritance, and that Song clan will compete with Cai clan and Ruo Lai clan for it. Old Eccentric Tian Nan is a Remote Antiquity Era refinement path supreme grandmaster on par with Old Immortal Kong Jue and Long Hair Ancestor, and historical records say he tried to refine the immemorial nine heavens and died after failing. Fighting for that inheritance has been a Song clan project for a hundred years.

Song clan wins ownership of Ascending Heaven Plain against Ruo Lai clan and Cai clan and obtains Old Eccentric Tian Nan’s true inheritance. Song Xia Qi reports that since gaining this refinement path true inheritance, Song clan has researched it and nurtured Gu Immortal seeds to make Tian Nan’s true inheritance a future signature strength. Even after three million years, the true inheritance still has immense value, and Song clan treats it as raising Immortal Gu refinement success rates for lasting clan benefit. When Qi Sea Ancestor asks to trade for it, Song Xia Qi stalls and Song clan decides not to sell, calling it the core inheritance of their clan’s future.

Song Qi Yuan tells his granddaughter that researching Tian Nan’s true inheritance has produced their first success as a water path Immortal Gu, which she must claim as a wild capture rather than flaunt as clan work.

Under ant-plague pressure and contribution-board rivalry, Song clan hands over Tian Nan’s true inheritance after Xia clan and Tang clan contribute molten casting and myriad fusion true inheritances. Fang Yuan obtains it with other refinement path true inheritances, and among the Righteous Qi Alliance contributions it ranks highest in value, placing Song clan at the top of the board. Inside, Old Eccentric Tian Nan describes ambitions to refine the immemorial two heavens and the five regions into an external immortal aperture, fails against heaven path dao marks, and dies after a risky attempt to refine the heavens. The same true inheritance also holds Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s notes: he once obtained it at Ascending Heaven Plain, kept and reinforced it for later generations, returned in his later years to add refinement path experience, and used it while scheming against beastman methods.
